facts.fact: Expansao says the Personal Data Protection Law has been in force in Angola since 2011.
facts.system: Lei de Proteccao de Dados Pessoais

facts.fact: The Agencia de Proteccao de Dados has operated since October 2019 and fines companies under the data protection rules.
The authority fined Empresa Publica de Aguas de Luanda the equivalent of USD 150,000 on 14 July 2026 for breaching data protection duties.
facts.system: Lei de Proteccao de Dados Pessoais
